glossary.definition: As used in this section, "petroleum" has the same meaning as in division (J) of section 3737.87 of the Revised Code, except that it does not include used oil.
glossary.source_title: Section 5501.38 - Reusing petroleum contaminated sands, gravel and soils as highway construction materials.

title: Section 5501.38 - Reusing petroleum contaminated sands, gravel and soils as highway construction materials.
